capture_contract.native_lookup: Engine-provided current Stockfish::scale_evaluation(raw+offset,VALUE_ZERO,actualPosition) and UCIEngine::to_cp for every integer raw offset -80..80 inclusive. Offset0 must match fresh ordinary current-source raw+CP. No missing/out-of-range imputation.
capture_contract.joint_delta_bound: Global L1<=16 and uint7<=127 imply absolute affine delta<=2032 and raw delta<80; every trial is checked against int32 and captured lookup bounds.
capture_contract.ordinary_eligibility: Both nonterminal, not-in-check children for pair loss; retain every unavailable parent/pair/child and measure every otherwise available child even if its counterpart is unavailable.

After ONE joint freeze and typed bytes, ALL measured candidate children require actual ordinary native raw+CP parity before any gate interpretation.

fit.head_selection: At least256 same-physical-head paired TRAIN roots and24 TRAIN components; choose at most4 by descending paired support then ascending physical head. Bind this student's actual map.
fit.edits: FC2 serialized signed-int8 coefficients only; no biases or other bytes. Deltas[-4,-2,-1,0,1,2,4], preserve[-128,127], max2 nonzero lanes/head,8 total,L1<=16.
fit.optimizer: ONE deterministic joint coordinate descent from identity; four full sweeps, selected heads ascending then lane0..127; consider every allowed final declared delta at each coordinate and current full joint vector. Stop if a full sweep makes no change. No restart or reselection.
fit.objective: Exact component-equal mean of root [Huber20(max(0,target-margin)) + ((newChildA-oldChildA)^2+(newChildB-oldChildB)^2)/2], plus sum(delta^2)/8. Huber20(e)=e^2/2 for e<=20 else20*(e-10). Anchors are original student ordinary CP, not teacher CP scale.
fit.arithmetic: Exact Fraction/integer sums. Equivalent LCM weights may optimize component-equal arithmetic; max8 roots/component bounds LCM<=840. Enforce integer overflow bounds or use Python exact integers; never approximate choices with float cost.
fit.ties: Exact cost, fewer changed lanes, smaller sum delta^2, smaller L1, lexicographic(head,lane,declared delta order). Identity wins ties.
fit.error_strata: Prospectively use the SOURCE-DEFINED semantic raw root route (piece-count band, root-STM queen bits, pawn layout and many-officers flag), crossed with A/B capture-or-promotion flags. Semantic routes are stable across compatible v20 checkpoints; stored physical head indices are not assumed portable.
fit.specific_error_selection: TRAIN only: >=128 stable eligible pairs,>=24 components, baseline component-equal rank error>=25%; choose highest error then lexical semantic descriptor. Old D1 head8 observation never selects a v20 stratum or coefficient.
fit.freeze: Freeze all edits or identity exactly ONCE before development outcomes. Bind full training/source/map/capture/cost-trace hashes, exact original/candidate bytes and inverse restore. No coordinate copying from any earlier candidate.
